note: v3: the seed breathes - the five voices drift up to half a beat and back, re-locking by 3:19
v6: first light - the seed's opening statement echoes out (ping-pong) and a low cello D swells under the intro
v7: the seed is recognised - the kalimba states E1 plainly on the crest as the five voices lock
v8: the shadow catches up - the cello cantus doubles its pace (E1 at half speed) into the fall
v16: the whistle tries the hook where the scattered cycles fall in phase (152 D A, 168 D A C, 176 D A C G), never the last E
v20: the hook first - the whistle's E1 alone over scatter and pedal at A, the band (bass, shekere, warm fifth) drops in two bars later
v21: the whistle states E1 once more as the lock exhales (300), then at half speed into the fall (320), handing the hook into the overlap
v22: the album breathes first - a soft airy 'haa' on D from the far choir before the whistle's first E1
v27: the seed alone - the five voices step out for the lock's 2nd phrase and the whistle plays E1 twice over the cell, cello and organ
v28: the voices fall together - each scattered voice bounces faster and faster into its place in E1 at the crest
v29: the floor walks the seed - the triangle bass leaves its D-A drone and walks E1 (D A C G E) at a quarter speed under the cello
v31: the voices let go - the mirror of the crest's bounce: each voice slows its repeats at its own rate as the lock ends
